<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has found a time and booked the meeting. My final task is to send the confirmation email to all the partners.

The meeting is on Thursday, November 19 at 2:30 PM. The meeting is 30 minutes long, so it will be from 2:30 PM to 3:00 PM. I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function. I will need to provide the day, start time, and body of the email.

- Day: "Thu"
- Start time: "14:30"
- Body: I will write a professional email confirming the meeting details.

After sending the email, the task will be complete, and I can end the session.I will send a confirmation email for the partners' meeting on Thursday, November 19, from 2:30 PM to 3:00 PM.
